text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: BStone is an open-source source port for the classic Blake Stone first-person shooter games, including Aliens of Gold and Planet Strike. It modernizes the original Wolfenstein 3D-based engine with improved compatibility, higher resolutions, widescreen support, smoother controls, and enhanced audio features while preserving the original gameplay. Blake Stone was notable for expanding the early first-person shooter formula with interactive environments, elevators, computer terminals, and a science-fiction setting.
